title: fix: confine polli-agent file serving to temp storage
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes the two high-severity CodeQL path-injection alerts in `apps/polli-agent/src/polli_agent/api.py`.
- Rejects path separators, resolves paths against the canonical temp-files root, enforces containment, and rejects files/symlinks outside that root.
- Adds regression coverage for valid files, traversal attempts, and escaping symlinks.
- Validation: full polli-agent suite passes (48 passed, 8 skipped); `git diff --check` is clean. Ruff reports only pre-existing app-wide issues.

gist.headline: Files stay in the garden
gist.blurb: Polli-agent now keeps served files neatly inside its temporary storage patch. Even adventurous paths and wandering symlinks get gently redirected to nowhere.
gist.summary: polli-agent file serving now accepts only files contained within its canonical temporary-files root, rejecting path separators, traversal attempts, and symlinks that resolve outside it.
gist.impact: Users of polli-agent can serve valid temporary output files as before, with stronger guarantees that file requests remain inside the app's intended workspace.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper at a cozy temporary-file garden, placing labeled file sprouts inside a small fenced planter while a retro terminal safely turns away tangled path vines trying to grow beyond the fence. The fence and planter represent canonical-root containment; include code-plants and a small lock-shaped garden gate to convey safe file access.
